data.title: Debt collection demand (Inkasso) for unpaid internet invoices – €131.48 total
data.summary: Inkassobüro Beispielrecht GmbH, acting for Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH, demands payment of €131.48 (unpaid August and September 2026 internet invoices plus a reminder fee and the collection agency's own fee) by 2 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is a payment demand from a debt collection agency (Inkassobüro) acting on behalf of your internet provider, Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH, over two unpaid invoices from August and September 2026. The total now claimed, €131.48, includes the original bills plus a reminder fee and the collector's own fee. Pay this amount to the account shown by the deadline shown to avoid further steps. If you believe you don't actually owe this money, write to the agency before the deadline explaining why, instead of paying; they say they will then check the matter with the provider. Since this isn't a court order, you are not legally required to pay immediately, but ignoring it may lead to further collection steps or a court procedure, so consider getting independent advice if you want to dispute it.

key_facts.label: Payment due date
key_facts.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.

key_facts.label: Previous letter date
key_facts.quote: Dieses Schreiben knüpft an unseren Brief vom 02.11.2026 unter dem Zeichen LS-9147-629 an.

items.title: Pay the total amount claimed by the collection agency
items.action: Transfer the total amount due to the Treuhandkonto shown on the letter by the deadline.
items.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.

items.title: Dispute the claim if you disagree
items.action: If you believe you don't owe this money, write to the agency stating your reasons for disputing the claim.
items.consequence: The agency says it will check the matter with the original creditor (Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH) before proceeding further.
items.quote: Wenn Sie die Forderung bestreiten, teilen Sie uns das bitte mit Begründung mit; wir klären den Sachverhalt dann mit unserer Auftraggeberin.
